definitions.explanation: Related to or supporting political revolution or radical change in government.
Involving or causing a complete or dramatic change; innovative to the point of changing everything.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{革命的|かくめいてき}な⟦{発明|はつめい}→発明：01495_hatsumei⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{革命的|かくめいてき}な⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{産業|さんぎょう}→産業：01419_sangyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}えた→変える：01089_kaeru⟧。
{革命的|かくめいてき}な⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{揺|ゆ}るがした→揺るがす：12936_yurugasu⟧。
examples.english: A revolutionary movement shook the nation.

notes:
FORMATION: ⟦{革命|かくめい}→革命：05968_kakumei⟧ (revolution) + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (adjectival suffix)

FORMS:
- {革命的|かくめいてき}な＋noun (attributive)
- {革命的|かくめいてき}に＋verb (adverbial)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {革命的|かくめいてき}な⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧ (revolutionary change)
- {革命的|かくめいてき}な⟦{発明|はつめい}→発明：01495_hatsumei⟧ (revolutionary invention)
- {革命的|かくめいてき}な⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧ (revolutionary technology)
- {革命的|かくめいてき}な⟦{思想|しそう}→思想：03173_shisou⟧ (revolutionary thought)

USAGE: In modern Japanese, {革命的|かくめいてき} is often used in sense 2 (groundbreaking, game-changing) in business and technology contexts, similar to English "revolutionary" in marketing language.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{革命|かくめい}→革命：05968_kakumei⟧ - revolution
- ⟦{画期的|かっきてき}→画期的：06826_kakkiteki⟧ - epoch-making, groundbreaking
- ⟦{先進的|せんしんてき}→先進的：20024_senshinteki⟧ - advanced, progressive
